show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/Rggya4
show.description:
This is a story of revenge. Nivan’s sister is sexually assaulted, and shockingly, his own wife and her best friend help protect the culprit. Betrayed and shattered, Nivan sets out to take revenge for the injustice done to him and his family. In this journey, he is joined by Meera, his childhood friend, who stands by him.
In the end, both women realize their mistakes, but by then, Nivan has already moved on with his life.
